notes: Reviewed covenant blessings and curses, repeated formulas, verbal idioms and contextual French expansions. The repeated phrase of resistance is translated idiomatically, not as an isolated equivalence for every morph. In 26:41 'péchés à cause desquels' is an explanatory connector to the preceding verse; no independent Hebrew lexical equivalent claimed.
